function: GNN maps far-field wide-beam gains of all users to each user's optimal near-field codeword (angle and distance indices) for beam training and hybrid precoding (p. 5-7).
system: TDD multiuser mmWave XL-MIMO downlink, BS with 256-antenna ULA and 8 RF chains, 8 single-antenna users, 30 GHz, near-field spherical wave, hybrid precoding; no RIS (p. 3, 9, 10).
method: GNN with three feature-updating layers (mean aggregation, concatenation), separate angle and distance networks; supervised classification on labeled channels; non-learned beam allocation and ZF/MMSE precoder (p. 6-7, 10).
data_channel: Wireless InSite ray tracing of the authors' own 40x30x5 m smart-factory scenario, 12000 channel samples with calculated labels, users randomly placed at 30 GHz (p. 9-10).
test_conditions: 90/10 split, K = 8 users; Figs. 10, 12 test 1 to 9 users; paper says no GNN retraining when users change (p. 3, 9, 10, 12).
baselines: Non-learned: exhaustive near-field search and OMP compressive-sensing channel estimation with MRC. Learned: FC network [16] and CNN [17] beam training (p. 10).
metrics: Sum rate, effective sum rate accounting for pilot time, and estimation accuracy of the optimal codeword versus uplink and downlink power and number of users (p. 10-12).
complexity: Order of complexity O(KV N_BS/M + KV^2 L_G + KV N_BS + KV S + K^3), Eq. 30; no runtime or FLOPs (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 9: "we utilized the WI software to create a wireless" scenario. The channels come from the authors' own ray-traced factory; no 3GPP, COST 2100 or DeepMIMO dataset and no measured data are used.
q2_support: p. 3: "be retrained when the number of users changes". Training uses K = 8 users (p. 9) and Figs. 10 and 12 test 1 to 9 users (p. 12); reuse of one network is implied by this claim, not stated for the runs.
q3_support: p. 10: "The OMP algorithm is a classical" compressive-sensing baseline, plus exhaustive search, are non-learned; p. 10: "In the FC neural network-based scheme" [16] and the CNN scheme [17] are learned; all are compared on sum rate and accuracy (p. 11-12).
q4_support: p. 9: "overall computational complexity is as follows", followed by Eq. 30 with the order O(KV N_BS/M + KV^2 L_G + KV N_BS + KV S + K^3).
q5_support: p. 10: "channel samples based on the given system parameters and" labels were generated by the authors. No link or DOI to code or data is given, and the data are not a public dataset.
notes: Beam training is graded as area 3 (beam selection and hybrid precoder design). q1 is 0 because Wireless InSite is a commercial ray tracer used on the authors' own scenario, not DeepMIMO or a shared dataset; the reviewer may confirm. q2 rests on the p. 3 claim of no retraining plus Figs. 10 and 12 at 1 to 9 users against K = 8 in the setup (p. 9); the paper never says that the same network was reused for those runs, and at K = 1 the GNN equals the FC curve in Fig. 10, so the reviewer should confirm. Learned baselines for q3 are FC [16] and CNN [17]. The 80 pilot symbols are overhead only and not counted for q4. PDF is the arXiv v2 preprint of the same paper.
